protocol.artifact_metric_scope: CPU consistency check of saved float32 arrays, never a substitute for recorded CUDA decisions
protocol.data_role: already exposed COCO development fixtures; no held-out or confirmation claim
forbidden: same-state speed described as end-to-end speed
protocol.gpu_monitor: nvidia-smi compute-process and utilization snapshots before/after each group and each measured pipeline; foreign compute PID or unreadable monitor makes timing ineligible; point samples do not prove continuous exclusivity
protocol.missing_policy: preserve every exception/error cell, no retry or in-place repair; incomplete matrix cannot support a positive decision

pipeline.aggregation: median paired baseline/candidate runtime across three seeds per image, then median across the two images; all six quality guardrails must hold
pipeline.exploratory_runtime: total minus measured observer seconds is not a causal uninstrumented runtime estimate
pipeline.finite_gate: baseline, A/A and candidate require finite PSNR/MS-SSIM/LPIPS, all finite native quality scalars, quality.finite=True, and final reference RGB error in [0,2e-5]
pipeline.mask: COCO9 full frame; COCO25 ellipse ((x-(W-1)/2)/(0.42W))^2+((y-(H-1)/2)/(0.42H))^2<=1, fixed pixel centers; not semantic segmentation
pipeline.observation: every native observer event: copy selected field to CPU and record complete native event including rejected candidates; offline score selected snapshots; rejected trial fields are not exposed by native API
pipeline.order: rotate five arms by (image index*3+seed) modulo five; new warmed process per cell
pipeline.scope: instrumented bounded complete pipeline, not the default 11000-row/full-step regime
pipeline.timing: whole run_pipeline including initialization, all scheduled stages, final render and CPU field-snapshot observer; synchronized; reporting/perceptual rescoring afterward excluded
pipeline.trajectory_gate: exact event/phase/reason/accepted/count/attempted/selected-index discrete projection for candidate and A/A; no final-count or selected-step mismatch; selected_iteration is the global attempted index of the last accepted native event

protocol.resize: Pillow RGB LANCZOS, round scaled width and height, no upscale
protocol.resource_scope: same-state call GPU allocated peaks; pipeline complete-call GPU allocated peaks and worker process peak RSS; parent and reporting costs separate

same_state.aa_timing_gate: within every image/state/seed, median ten paired legacy_a/legacy_b call-time ratios must lie in [0.9,1.1]; all sixteen image/state/seed pairs must pass; per-image AA medians are descriptive only
same_state.aggregation: median ten paired per-round baseline/candidate ratios within state/seed; median four state/seed ratios within image; median across four images
same_state.correctness_gate: all cells finite; all measured and replay RGB errors <=2e-5; exact replay hole masks and exact all decision/reason vectors; scalar quality deltas all reported without dropping fields
same_state.decisions: each round: legacy_a state to each arm same state (null); initial legacy_a to terminal arm; terminal legacy_a to initial arm; compare exact boolean/reasons to legacy_a counterpart
same_state.order: five cyclic rotations of arms, then reversals of those five rotations
same_state.parent_config: benchmarks.fit050_controls.parent_configs(seed), exact full dictionaries in each parent config
same_state.parent_source: required completed clean FIT-050 bundle at the same source commit; copy and hash initial/terminal fields, target, configs, history and optimizer state; no selection/refitting
same_state.parity: all ten measured RGB images and quality vectors retained; separate untimed instrumented replay captures same-call RGB/denominator, hole mask and fallback count; coverage parity is replay-to-replay, not a bitwise claim about another atomic call
same_state.timing: one complete uninstrumented evaluate_quality per round/arm; CUDA synchronize immediately before and after; serialization, parity replay and perceptual metrics excluded

protocol.scoring: raw float64-accumulated PSNR/MSE; display-clamped SSIM/MS-SSIM/LPIPS, raw MAE and complete native safe-quality vector
protocol.warmup: new worker: tiny procedural 32x32 five-Gaussian normalized CUDA field, all five quality modes twice; pipeline worker additionally runs complete capacity16 step_scale0.001 full-frame pipeline once
